question.text: The maximum exit load in the FIRST year of PMS investment is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI's PMS exit-load schedule, the maximum exit load is 3% in the first year, 2% in the second year, and 1% in the third year, with no exit load after three years. The first-year cap is therefore 3%. The Trap: 1% and 2% are the caps for the third and second years respectively, not the first. 5% sits outside the prescribed schedule entirely. Note: Distributor-style pro-tip and cross-exam framing removed; explanation grounded in pp.96 and 116 (3/2/1% exit-load schedule), with the MITC/fee-tool reference appropriately tied to p.109.
